simple.meaning: קֶלֶס (qeleç) is a Hebrew word meaning “a laughing-stock.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קֶלֶס (H7047) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 44:14, with occurrences in Psalms, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֶלֶס (H7047) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קֶלֶס (H7047) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קֶלֶס (qeleç) / H7047 is traced through Psalms 44:14, Psalms 79:4, Jeremiah 20:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
